items.title: watermarks-remover

items.summary: An open-source tool removes AI provenance marks, Unicode text hygiene, and metadata from various file formats. It supports PNG, JPEG, PDF, DOCX, HTML, and Markdown. It does not claim to remove all AI watermarks.

items.title: WeChat-AI
items.summary: WeChat has implemented stricter rules to ban non-human automated content, and it is developing AI agents for enhanced user interactions and service orchestration. The AI agents are in an internal testing phase.

items.title: eve-software-factory-template
items.description: Meet Foreman, an eve Software Factory.
items.summary: Foreman is an AI-driven software factory that automates development workflows by creating draft pull requests from GitHub and Linear tasks. It uses AI agents at each stage to review and refine code, keeping human judgment for final decisions. The factory learns from each run to improve future processes.

items.title: enterprise-system-design
items.description: A source-grounded course & reference for engineers designing systems that must survive real traffic, partial failure, security review, and changing requirements, spanning enterprise system design, distributed systems, AI systems, cybersecurity, reliability, cloud, HPC, edge, and mission-critical infrastructure.
items.summary: Enterprise system design focuses on building scalable, secure, and reliable systems for mission-critical applications. Key areas include distributed systems, cloud architecture, and cybersecurity. Essential principles involve fault tolerance and zero-trust security models.

items.title: agent-safe-pipeline
items.description: Reference architecture for AI agents that propose actions but cannot authorize them — immutable intent capture, an independent Decionis policy verdict (ALLOW/ESCALATE/BLOCK), verified human approval, and a SafeExecutor that consumes a single-use intent-bound grant.
items.summary: An agent-safe pipeline ensures AI agents propose actions but not authorize them, with intent verification, policy verdict, human approval, and a SafeExecutor for execution. It prevents unsafe actions through strict policy enforcement and human oversight.

items.title: dsh-vision-toolkit
